observed.caption: Four dark statues jointly raise a flag on a stone monument under a blue sky with scattered clouds.
observed.description: A large stone monument base made of light brown layered blocks occupies the lower portion of the image, with a small rectangular plaque mounted on its lower left side and a dark arched opening on the lower right. On top of the base stand four dark, weathered statues of human figures in dynamic poses jointly holding a long silver flagpole angled upward to the left, topped with a spear finial. A flag with horizontal black, red, and green stripes separated by thin white lines and a central shield emblem hangs from the pole, showing some discoloration. The background is a bright blue sky with scattered white clouds, with the dark green top of a tree visible behind the base on the far left and a small patch of foliage at the bottom right edge, and a small dark spotlight fixture sits on the top surface of the base near the statues' feet.
